verdict.rationale: Vercel's CLI supports a single-command flow: 'npm i -g vercel' then 'vercel' scaffolds/deploys, with zero-config framework detection (40+ frameworks) and git-push-to-deploy alternatives. Docs and GitHub both confirm 'import a project, choose a template, or use the Vercel CLI... git push to deploy' and the getting-started guide frames it as install CLI + deploy in three steps. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the exact scaffold-then-deploy UX (e.g., 'vercel init' template scaffolding flow) and no community corroboration of a truly single-command end-to-end scaffold+deploy experience.
